default/32567.htm.text: Shilen Priest Relrikia: May the great goddess of death be praised... A new world order is coming...

Q10270_BirthOfTheSeed/32567-01.html.text: Shilen's Priest Lelrikia: No outsider has ventured here for a long time. Doombringer1 creature, what brought you here?

links.text: "Tell me about the magical power of the Seed."

Q10270_BirthOfTheSeed/32567-06.html.text: Shilen's Priest Lelrikia: You'd best leave now.

links.text: "Okay. I will go to the fortress."

Q10272_LightFragment/32567-01.html.text: Shilen Priest Lelrikia: No outsider has ventured here for a long time. Doombringer1 creature, what brought you here?

links.text: Ask about a girl dressed as a witch in the Seed of Destruction.

Q10272_LightFragment/32567-05.html.text: Shilen Priest Lelrikia: I have nothing more to say. Go now.

Q10270_BirthOfTheSeed/32567-02.html.text: Shilen's Priest Lelrikia: Ah, is that why you dare to disturb me! Very well, I will tell you. The Seed is a power that once existed in Shilen's realm, the so-called world of death. To you it would seem like another dimension. As you approach its center, you can draw upon an amazing amount of magic …

Q10270_BirthOfTheSeed/32567-03.html.text: Shilen's Priest Lelrikia: The Seed acts somewhat like a mirror, reflecting the original nature of the lord who controls the Seed. The current Seed of Infinity is the most powerful of the Seeds in Gracia. Strong young men attracted by Lord Ekimus' power gathered there, and now their essences have be…

Q10270_BirthOfTheSeed/32567-04.html.text: Shilen's Priest Lelrikia: If you understand the characteristics of this Seed, it might help you. Frankly, though, it likely won't change the outcome. In any event, I have nothing more to say. Leave now.

links.text: "Okay. I will go to the fortress."

Q10270_BirthOfTheSeed/32567-05.html.text: Shilen's Priest Lelrikia: Doombringer1 creature, either you submit to the will of Shilen or you will die. Even now, the shadow of death looms...

Q10272_LightFragment/32567-02.html.text: Shilen Priest Lelrikia: Are you talking about Tiat, the witch of the Dark Black Dragon? I can tell you what I know of her...

Q10272_LightFragment/32567-03.html.text: Shilen Priest Lelrikia: The Dark Black Dragon was a follower of Shilen and widely regarded as one of the most powerful Dragons in existence. But it is imprisoned just like the goddess herself... That's the official history. But how can you explain the Seed of Destruction if the Dragon's power remai…

Q10272_LightFragment/32567-04.html.text: Shilen Priest Lelrikia: All these stories are probably not very helpful...you must want to know Tiat's weaknesses. Reflect on what I said. If she inherited his power, she must have inherited his limitations as well... I have no more to say. Go now.
